readerCopy.body: The humanitarian narrative faces the workers and communities documenting what the campaign left out. Neptune opposite Pluto can put genuine compassion directly across from private contracts, controlled access, or cleanup assigned to people with no authority. The cause may still be worthy while the institution speaking for it loses credibility. Separate the need from the organization claiming to represent it. Support the people doing the work, and inspect who is controlling the money and the story around them.
